title: cymbispatha commelinoides var. rotundifolia

This plant is used in traditional medicine due to its numerous health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
